meta.title: GrindStats — track the work, not the mood
meta.description: Body metrics, resistance and cardio training, and meal logging — measured properly, every single day.

hero.subhead: GrindStats records what you actually did, and does the arithmetic honestly.

features.heading: What it measures
features.metrics_body: Weight, body fat, muscle mass and circumferences, at whatever cadence you actually keep.
features.training_body: Resistance work by hard sets per muscle. Cardio by energy cost, afterburn included.
features.nutrition_body: Photograph the plate from two angles. Correct the estimate. Move on.
features.coaching_body: Advice built from your own numbers, with the number behind every recommendation shown.

how_it_works.heading: How it works
how_it_works.step_log_body: Check off each task as you finish it. Add what you improvised.
how_it_works.step_measure_body: Nothing is prescribed on fewer than 21 days of data. Trends need time, not enthusiasm.
how_it_works.step_adapt_body: Your energy expenditure is estimated from what actually happened to your weight, not from a formula's guess.
